name: Jörgen Warborn - Abrogation de la Directive (UE) 2024/1760 - Am 83
title: REPORT on the proposal for a directive of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Directives 2006/43/EC, 2013/34/EU, (EU) 2022/2464 and (EU) 2024/1760 as regards certain corporate sustainability reporting and due diligence requirements
part_text: (b) the following point (w) is added: ‘(w) ‘reasonably available information’ means information which can be obtained by the company from its own, or from existing or secondary sources without contacting a business partner.’;
